content.title: Nvidia taps TSMC for more H200 chips due to China demand: Reuters
content.description:
Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre tracks Wednesday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Mortgage rates were at their lowest level of 2025 through Tuesday, with the 30-year rate at 6.15%, according to data from Freddie Mac (FMCC).

Nvidia (NVDA) has reportedly asked Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM) to ramp up production of its H200 artificial intelligence (AI) to meet high demand, according to Reuters.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.title: Wall Street Gets a Taste of Blockbuster Stock-Market Debuts Ahead
content.summary: Wall Street is getting a glimpse of what could be the biggest year ever for IPOs in the U.S.  After four years of choppiness in the market for new stock offerings, bankers and investors are bracing for a slate of blockbuster listings in 2026—and wondering if the market can handle the torrent.  Medline’s  stock market debut Wednesday could offer an early gauge of whether investors will be up for it.
